scope: Observed internal author/reviewer attempts; not changes to the frozen run and not attributed causally to the refined definition. First author means the submitted pre-review artifact after its own self-checks, not the first JSON bytes written.

findings.finding: Data States were initially given physical components. Existing structural validation rejected them; authors repaired the representation before submitting.
findings.followup: Keep the validator. Explicitly distinguish collections of data records from material components in the shared State instructions; test separately from the information-effect comparison.

findings.finding: One self-check passed card.json as --registry, yielding misleading unknown-source/metadata errors. The author reran with source_registry.json.
findings.followup: Fail early with a clear registry-type error, or bind card and registry into an attempt-specific checking tool instead of asking the model to repeat paths.

findings.finding: Reviewers initially confused the canonical candidate hash with a raw-file SHA256. Assertions or binding validation failed; subsequent attempts used the declared candidate identity correctly.
findings.followup: Explain the two hash meanings and expose a single candidate-identity helper; do not ask the model to reconstruct the hash algorithm.

findings.finding: An optional jsonschema import failed; the author continued with the installed project checking tool.
findings.followup: Use the provided checker rather than optional dependencies. No evidence that Python assembly itself caused the scientific error under investigation.

findings.finding: Sandbox namespace failures are recorded separately from extraction errors; approved command escalation then allowed execution under Sherlock policy.
findings.followup: Retain managed approval behavior. Do not disable the sandbox to reduce overhead.

findings.finding: A positive correction check cited only one side of a source discrepancy; validation required evidence for both the catalogue and primary-paper version. The reviewer added the missing evidence before acceptance.
findings.followup: Retain the existing two-source correction check.
